text: hey, so I'm 16 and I'm watching my baby sister tonight, she's 5 months old. Mum and dad are at a wedding a couple of hours away and they said to message here if anything came up rather than ring them every five minutes lol. Basically she's had a runny nose since yesterday, like it's either running or it sounds a bit blocked, and she's been sneezing loads. I took her temperature with the ear thermometer because she felt a bit hot when I picked her up and it said 38.5. I did it twice and I think it came out the same both times but I'm not 100% sure I'm doing it properly, I've only seen mum use it. I don't really know what counts as a high temperature for a baby that small, I think it's different from older kids? I've not given her anything because I didn't want to get the dose wrong. She's in her cot now. I can ring mum if I need to, I just didn't want to panic her if this is normal for a cold. Let me know what I should do I guess
